title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：tension　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tension 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the elder ① felt the tension that no youth in the village would have noted, and he said the feeling was the whole of the year. The ② tension, meaning the strain itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; tension, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ bit of tension in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ tension at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Tension, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the elder said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tension was the whole of the matter, meaning the pressure and not the strain. The ⑥ tension, meaning the pressure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; tension, he said, is either something you feel or the only word that means both strain and a pressure. He said the pressure is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ tension had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ tension of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of noting; tension, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tension I remember is the tension noted in the memoir, which closed in 1989 and is still noted as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Tension, my mother said in 1991, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all tension, she said, is a pressure that has agreed to look like strain. She said the pressure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 紧张；张力（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 紧张；张力（指那分紧张本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：feel the tension 感到这一分紧张
D. n. 紧张；张力（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 紧张之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的紧张之事）
F. n. 紧张；张力（指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一分）
G. n. 紧张、压力（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 压力（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: felt the tension that no youth in the village would have noted
The tension, meaning the strain itself and not the staff
Every bit of tension in that village
the tension at the far gate
the tension was the whole of the matter
the tension had become a line in a memoir
The tension of the whole thing

answers.why: feel the tension 意为“感到这一分紧张”，1982 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记下的一分紧张做了一遍。
tension 意为“紧张；张力”，指那分紧张本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
tension 意为“紧张；张力”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
tension 意为“紧张；张力”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tension 意为“紧张、压力”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分压力就是那件事的全部。
tension 意为“压力”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分紧张，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tension 意为“紧张；张力”，指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一分，到 1987 年这一分成了回忆录里的一行。
tension 意为“紧张之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的紧张之事是一处村子和三个年头的记下。
tension 意为“紧张；张力”，我记得的是回忆录里记下过的那一分，1989 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一分。
tension 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，紧张是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的紧张。
